name: Ancho Reyes
tagline: Smoked ancho chile, centuries-old recipe.
description: Made from rehydrated ancho chiles macerated for months before distillation, following a recipe dating to 1927 in Puebla. Deep smoked-pepper heat balanced with a raisin-like sweetness.

name: Belvedere 10
tagline: Rare Diamond Rye, single harvest perfection.
description: Crafted from a single harvest of organic Diamond Dankowskie Rye from a single estate. Distilled four times and rested for ten months to create unparalleled velvety softness.

name: Belvedere Organic Vodka
tagline: Pure, organic Polska rye and natural well water.
description: Certified organic rye vodka distilled using time-honored Polish traditions. Clean, subtle, and incredibly smooth with zero artificial additives.

name: Blavod Black Vodka
tagline: Catechu-black, wheat-clean.
description: Triple-distilled British wheat vodka infused with natural catechu tree extract. Delivers a striking ink-black appearance without altering the classic, crisp vodka finish.

name: Blue Curaçao
tagline: Sun-dried Laraha orange peels in electric blue.
description: Vibrant blue liqueur flavored with the dried peel of the native Laraha citrus fruit. Essential for adding tropical orange warmth and high-contrast color to cocktails.

name: Celosa Rose Tequila
tagline: Joven Tequila rested in French Oak red wine casks.
description: Ultra-premium 100% organic agave Tequila finished in freshly emptied Napa Valley red wine barrels, imparting a delicate blush rose tint and subtle berry warmth.

name: Clase Azul Añejo
tagline: Aged 25 months in American whiskey casks.
description: A tribute to indigenous Mazahua culture housed in an iconic hand-painted ceramic decanter. Rich and full-bodied with complex wood-aged agave depth.

name: Clase Azul Gold
tagline: An exquisite blend of Plata and extra-aged Tequila.
description: A rare Joven tequila created by combining Clase Azul Plata with a special Reposado aged in French oak casks and an Extra Añejo finished in sherry casks.

name: Clase Azul Plata
tagline: Bright, unaged blue agave with crystal-clear elegance.
description: Crafted from slow-cooked organic Weber Blue Agaves. Unaged and crisp, capturing the sweet, pure essence of the agave plant.

name: Clase Azul Reposado
tagline: Masterfully aged for 8 months in bourbon barrels.
description: Recognized worldwide by its iconic hand-painted blue ceramic decanter. Smooth and silky with distinct notes of vanilla and candied wood.

name: Clase Azul Ultra Añejo
tagline: Aged 5 years in sherry casks with 24k gold leaf decanter.
description: The crown jewel of the Clase Azul distillery. Aged for five years in American whiskey and Spanish sherry casks, presented in a black decanter painted with platinum and 24-karat gold.

name: The Dalmore 18 Year Old
tagline: Matured in ex-bourbon oak and rare Matusalem sherry casks.
description: An exceptional Highland single malt matured for 18 years. Rich, bold, and complex with deep notes of dark chocolate and spiced citrus.

name: Diplomático Ambassador Rum
tagline: Aged 12 years in white oak and finished 2 years in Pedro Ximénez casks.
description: Crafted from pure sugarcane honeys and aged in former bourbon barrels before a finishing period in rich Pedro Ximénez sherry casks. Unfiltered and bottled at cask strength.

name: Empress 1908 Indigo Gin
tagline: Butterfly pea blossom infused color-changing gin.
description: Micro-distilled with eight botanicals including Fairmont Empress Hotel tea and butterfly pea blossom, giving it a natural indigo hue that turns pink when acid is added.

name: Empress 1908 Elderflower Rose Gin
tagline: All-natural ruby rose gin infused with elderflower and red rose petals.
description: Distilled with nine botanicals including black carrot, elderflower, and red rose petals. Pours a stunning translucent ruby pink.

name: Hapusa Himalayan Dry Gin
tagline: Wild Himalayan juniper, gondhoraj lime, and spices.
description: Distilled in India using wild juniper harvested from the high altitudes of the Himalayas, alongside local botanicals like raw mango, turmeric, and cardamom.

name: Hpnotiq
tagline: Cognac, vodka, and tropical fruit in electric blue.
description: A neon-blue liqueur blending French vodka, cognac, and tropical fruit juices. Created for high-contrast visual builds and vibrant shots.

name: Jaisalmer Indian Craft Gin
tagline: Royal Indian craft gin with Darjeeling green tea and cubeb pepper.
description: Triple-distilled in copper pot stills with 11 botanicals sourced from all across India, including vetiver, coriander, lemongrass, and orange peel.

name: Jaisalmer Gold Indian Craft Gin
tagline: Infused with saffron and filtered through 999.9 pure gold leaf.
description: A luxurious expression infused with hand-picked Kashmiri saffron and passed through golden leaf filters, creating a rich golden tint and velvety mouthfeel.

name: Laneta Extra Añejo Tequila
tagline: Aged 3 years in charred American white oak casks.
description: Crafted from 100% blue Weber agave cooked in brick ovens and aged for a minimum of 36 months, presented in a handcrafted skull decanter.

name: Lustre Cream Liqueur Trio
tagline: Plant-based vegan cream liqueur in Pineapple, Strawberry & Caffe Latte.
description: Smooth plant-based cream liqueurs blended with rum, tequila, or vodka. Delivers a rich, silky texture without any dairy.

name: Obsidian Artisanal Gin
tagline: Botanical-forward gin, activated-charcoal black.
description: London Dry gin base infused with juniper, black cardamom, and smoked tea, finished with reversed charcoal filtration to leave a deliberate ink-black tint.

name: Three Wrens Obsidian Gin
tagline: Distilled with smoked lapsang souchong, cacao, and roasted coffee.
description: An award-winning dark gin distilled with roasted coffee beans, cacao nibs, and lapsang souchong tea leaves for a rich, dark botanical character.

name: Patrón El Alto Reposado (Green Bottle)
tagline: Masterfully blended Reposado, Añejo, and Extra Añejo.
description: Crafted from 100% Weber Blue Agave in the Highlands of Jalisco. Blended across 11 different oak barrel types to achieve an exceptionally smooth finish.

name: Patrón El Alto Extra Añejo (Blue Bottle)
tagline: Pinnacle of luxury Tequila, smooth and deeply aged.
description: Highland agave slow-cooked in brick ovens and distilled in small copper pot stills, then aged to perfection for luxurious smoothness.

name: Vavoom Premium Vodka
tagline: Handcrafted 100% gluten-free corn vodka in sculpted glass.
description: Distilled five times and finished with a proprietary ultra-fine filtration process, encased inside an iconic, custom hand-blown glass sculpture bottle.
